A clean brand identity board for six fictional companies that all live in the same playful universe and are all quietly inspired by penguins or Antarctica. Premium modern flat vector logos with tasteful bold typography, each a different style, arranged in a 3x2 grid with generous spacing on a warm off-white page. Each logo crisp and readable, spelled exactly as written, no other text, no mockups, no people.
